title: [FEATURE] Ask questions for compaction
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

While new plan confirmation with "Do plan, and clear context" is great feature and I use it very often, I've had situation when I was managing Ansible playbooks from remote servers along with sshing onto those servers and didn't really dumped all that into into CLAUDE.md.

So what I needed is to preserve as much important information as possible between many prompts so I stil have important stuff in memory.

Claude Code currently can ask nice questions for planning and it is great feature.

It would be nice adding questions into `/compact` command :)


### Proposed Solution

I've tried this, but it didn't asked me anything :(

As a "proposed solution", just hinting to ask questions would be enough - but it would be wise enough to ask questions itself like it asks for planning already.

```
/compact remember we're working on server installation ansible playbooks. remember important file names, server names so we can continue our work. Forget about problems we had, we fixed them all and we'll continue with other tasks. if you cant (i
don't know if you have this possibility, but would be cool! so... maybe try?) -> ask me more specific questions about what to remember
```

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

Low - Nice to have

### Feature Category

Interactive mode (TUI)

### Use Case Example

Use case already explained.

### Additional Context

Already explained.
